heading: Broadcom's Q3 FY2026 Results: A Deep Dive for Indian Investors
tldr: Broadcom reported strong Q3 FY2026 results, surpassing revenue and adjusted EPS expectations.
Revenue reached $29.6 billion, exceeding estimates, driven significantly by AI semiconductor demand.
AI semiconductor revenue surged to $16.7 billion, demonstrating 221% year-over-year growth.
The company also reported robust cash flow from operations at $14.2 billion and free cash flow of $13.7 billion.
Despite strong numbers, the stock experienced a slight dip, indicating high investor expectations for future guidance.
caption:
Ever wondered what makes big tech companies tick? Broadcom, a huge chipmaker, just shared its latest earnings. They made more money than expected, especially from chips used in AI – that's the smart tech behind things like ChatGPT! Even though they did well, their stock dipped a bit, showing how much investors expect. Want to know why this matters for your money? Read the full article to find out!
